variety_description: High yielding, mid-early maturity, medium height, with medium slender grain. Developed by PJTSAU, Hyderabad and released in 2015 as an alternative to MTU-1010 which of late has developed susceptibility to major pests and diseases. Recommended for transplanting in irrigated lowland ecosystem. High HRR and test weight. Less prone to grain shattering and lodging during harvest.
